description: If an arithmetic structure \(M\) contains an element unequal to every numeral value, then it is not isomorphic to \(\mathbb N_A\).
signature:
Lemmatheca.ModelTheory.ArithmeticTheories.no_standard_isomorphism.{u} (M : Type u)
  [Lemmatheca.ModelTheory.ArithmeticTheories.language.Structure M] (a : M)
  (ha : ∀ (n : ℕ), a ≠ Lemmatheca.ModelTheory.ArithmeticTheories.numeralValue M n) :
  ¬Nonempty (Lemmatheca.ModelTheory.ArithmeticTheories.language.Equiv ℕ M)
